statement: For the strict prefix-causal online bin-packing template, replacing the worst-fit residual preference in score_bin with a tightest-feasible-residual (Best Fit) preference, optionally plus an exact-fit bonus and a large-item gate, weakly decreases total bin count on cvrp_dev_hetero_24 instances of size 50/100/200 without increasing wall-clock mean above the 500 ms budget.
rationale: Rounds 1-2 stagnated at mean objective 27.8333 with zero VBS gap closure and Worst-Fit-style scoring; Johnson et al. best-fit tightest-residual placement is the standard complementary switch and is cheap (O(open bins) per item).
